puzzle.hint: Describes the arrival of a divine decree that should not be hastened
puzzle.arabicVerse: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
puzzle.verse: 16:1 - The command of Allāh is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
